summary: All 46 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all six computations reproduced. The selected-gene comparison stands: 12 of 19 ARC directions agree, below the 30-pair concordance minimum. Figure 8B reports 174 discoveries. None of the 13,452 published registered genes passes FDR < 0.01. The corrected proposal passes the repository validator.
openIssues: The local QC summary reports 305 genes at FDR < 0.05. Both gene-level tables give zero. The live QC file returned HTTP 403.
The authors’ ARC gene-level results and model details are needed to explain the 174 discoveries. The registered FDR calculation included 27 additional unmapped features whose results are unpublished.
The registry describes obese-diabetic mice and names only IP118. The sequencing cohort was lean and received IP118 plus PY115. The paper and GEO also name different RNA extraction kits.
